title: The agent cannot approve itself
goal: An agent buys something, but big purchases need a person.
obstacle: An agent that approves its own risky calls is no control at all.
control: The gateway holds the call and waits for an approval on a separate channel.

steps.title: Hold
steps.tell: The gateway refuses to forward the call and asks for approval.
steps.say: The agent asked; the gateway said not yet.
steps.why: The approval channel is one the agent cannot reach.

steps.title: Approve
steps.tell: The approver says yes out of band; the retry is forwarded.
steps.say: A person said yes somewhere the agent cannot type.
steps.why: Approval is bound to this call, not to the agent.
